newsitem.title: UK: Principal Hotels to float at 100 million stg.
newsitem.headline: Principal Hotels to float at 100 million stg.

text.p: British hotels group Principal Hotels Ltd said on Monday it will float on the stock exchange through a placing later this autumn.

Principal, which has 21 hotels, said it expects the flotation will give it a market capitalisation of around 100 million stg. The hotels portfolio covers 16 in England, with others in Edinburgh, Dublin, Copenhagen and Amsterdam.
In the year ended October 29, 1995, Principal had operating profit of 8.1 million stg on turnover of 42.6 million, with average room yield of 25.60 stg, the company said in a statement.

The full prospectus for the flotation will include a profit forecast for the current year, and Principal said it anticipated that operating profit and room yield would be "significantly ahead" of last year.

Principal joins a list of hotel groups intending to float in London at a time when hotels in the UK are enjoying an upswing in trading. Others include Thistle Hotels, being floated by New Zealand's Brierley Investments Ltd, and Lonrho's Metropole and Princess hotels. The latter has postponed its flotation due to interest from potential buyers.
